benchmark: one real UK Biobank T1 converted from FreeSurfer orig/001.mgz, registered to FSL MNI152 T1 2-mm template
source_provenance: The available orig/001.mgz is a FreeSurfer-derived file; byte identity with scanner raw T1 is unverified.
input_pairing: All three brain-to-brain runs use the identical FNIT SynthStrip T1 brain and identical MNI152 2-mm brain template. The separate FSL whole-head run uses the same T1 before brain extraction and the whole-head template, including whole-head FLIRT initialization.

execution.fnit_device: NVIDIA H100 PCIe CUDA with TF32 allowed, FP32 image and displacement field
execution.timing_caveat: FNIT ran while unrelated GPU tasks were active. These single-run times are observed durations, not a controlled speed comparison.
execution.fsl_validation: This FSL installation returned 255 even after writing outputs. All reported FLIRT/FNIRT NIfTI outputs and coefficients passed gzip CRC, NiBabel grid and finite-value checks; both affine matrices were finite and invertible. The reference is conditionally accepted with exit status retained.

metric_definitions.image_pearson: Pearson r of warped T1 intensities within the MNI152 2-mm brain mask; input pairs use the same brain-extracted T1.
metric_definitions.support_dice: Dice of masks created by thresholding each warped T1 above 5% of its positive 99th percentile; compared with the FSL same-brain output or the MNI brain mask as named.
metric_definitions.median_normalized_mae: Each warped T1 divided by its positive median within the MNI brain mask, then mean absolute difference within that mask.
metric_definitions.pull_coordinate_difference_mm: FSL applywarp resampled three T1 RAS-world coordinate images to MNI; Euclidean distance to MNI world plus FNIT dense pull field, within the common valid brain support.

fsl_whole_head_input.note: This run uses whole-head T1 and template, unlike FNIT brain-to-brain registration; it is not a paired numerical comparator.
